## About this page

How the app's own symbols, the marks beside your items, and the tiles in Settings are drawn.

#### How it works

App icons are the symbols on buttons, tabs and menus. Site icons are the marks beside each item in the vault list. Settings icons are the small tiles beside rows like these.

See also [App icons](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-icon-style), [Site icons](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-style), [Style](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-settings-icons).

<a id="setting-icon-style"></a>

## App icons

The style of the symbols on buttons, tabs and menus. Every choice is a version of Material Symbols.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Material Symbols | The standard look. |
| Material Symbols Rounded | Softer corners. |
| Material Symbols Sharp | Square corners. |
| Rounded light | Thin strokes and soft corners. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

Site marks are not changed by this. They have their own choice under [Site icons](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-style).

See also [Site icons](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-style).

<a id="setting-site-icon-style"></a>

## Site icons

How the mark beside each item is drawn: in the site's own colors, in one color, or as a letter.

#### How it works

Marks for well-known sites come from Simple Icons and ship with the app, so drawing one never asks anyone anything.

An item with no known mark shows the first letter of its website or name. A card, note or other item with no website shows its type's symbol instead.

A color you chose for one item always wins over the brand's.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Brand colors | Each site's mark on its own brand color. A brand color too close to the background falls back to the theme's tone. |
| Colored marks | Each mark in its brand color, on one shared background. |
| One color | Every mark in the same color, on one shared background. |
| Letters | First letters only, no logos. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

The logos remain their owners' trademarks. WM Pass shows them only to say which site an item is for.

See also [Shape](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-shape), [Icons](/guide/settings/list/#setting-row-icons).

<a id="setting-site-icon-shape"></a>

## Shape

The shape of the tile behind each site mark.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Circle | A round tile, as in a contacts app. |
| Rounded | A square with soft corners. |
| Square | A square with barely rounded corners. |
| No background | The mark alone, drawn larger, with no tile behind it. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Site icons](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-style).

<a id="setting-settings-icons"></a>

## Style

How the small tiles beside rows in Settings are drawn.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Colored | Each page has its own color, worn by its rows and by the row that leads to it, so a color comes to mean a place. |
| One color | Every tile in the same quiet tone. |
| No background | The symbol alone, in the page's color, with no tile behind it. |
| None | No icons, only the words. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Icons](/guide/settings/icons/).

<a id="setting-settings-cards"></a>

## Cards

*Only in Android.*

Draws each group of settings on a card. Off, the rows sit straight on the page under each group's heading.

#### Limits

Only the Standard style follows this. Glass always draws its settings on cards.

See also [Style](/guide/settings/look/#setting-ui-style).
